english.title: Remain on Luton Airport after being request to leave by an airport official / a constable
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having been requested to leave Luton Airport by an airport official or a constable having reasonable grounds to believe that your presence had been responsible for or was about to be responsible for a byelaw or criminal offence, remained on the airport
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 2.24 and 7.2 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.
